## Definition of done (ES-037)

- [ ] Intended behaviour works, with meaningful tests for new or changed logic (or a recorded reason there are none)
- [ ] `make validate` passes locally and every CI check is green
- [ ] No secrets introduced; no production data used
- [ ] New dependencies are approved in `docs/dependencies.md`
- [ ] Docs, ADRs and the conformance ledger are updated where affected
- [ ] Runtime changes include how they are diagnosed and verified after deployment
- [ ] UI changes pass automated accessibility checks
- [ ] Final review done by the owner, or by a separate reviewer context under the CLAUDE.md envelope
